facts.summary: Dosing stopped at higher cohort after two dose-limiting toxicities (respiratory SAEs) · Phase 1/2 · MGTA-117 in relapsed/refractory AML and MDS · not yet approved
facts.indication: relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndrome

evidence.summary: it has stopped dosing participants at the Cohort 4 dosing level (0.13 mg/kg) and plans to dose additional participants at the Cohort 3 dosing level (0.08 mg/kg).
evidence.safety: This SAE was subsequently determined to be the second DLT in Cohort 4, thereby triggering prespecified stopping rules for further dosing in Cohort 4.
